The '''Onderonian navy''', specified in [[Iziz News]] broadcasts as the ''Onderon Space Force'', was a sizable defense fleet of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] and subsidiary of the [[Onderonian military]]. It was composed of both [[Foray-class blockade runner]]s, as well as [[Aurek-class tactical strikefighter]]s. After the [[Jedi Civil War]], Onderon's commander-in-chief, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Vaklu]], used the navy to initialize a self-imposed blockade of the planet, searching all ships for "[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] dissidents", in an attempt to put economic pressure on [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Talia (Onderon)|Talia]], so that she would be more open to the idea of secession.

The blockade and lengthy searches of each and every arriving ship created a long line to get into the [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] [[Iziz Starport|Starport]], creating a tense atmosphere and ruining merchant shipping schedules. The Onderonian navy briefly fought a fleet of commercial ships in waiting to land on their planet, after it attempted to destroy the ''[[Ebon Hawk]]'', a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] vessel, inadvertently causing the nervous freighter fleet into thinking it was coming under fire. The merchant ships returned fire and the Onderonian navy lost a number of single-seat fighters and possible damage to some of its capital ships before the fighting was stopped.

The navy was most likely divided in its loyalties just as the ground forces of Onderon were during the [[Onderon Civil War]], but what happened in the Onderonian navy during the war is unknown.
